answer: Anchor every agent identity to a basalt-solid registry stake: to register, an agent locks a deposit that vests over months, and the required deposit doubles for each additional identity funded from the same wallet, so a farm cannot spin up fakes in parallel. One extra identity costs one fresh doubled stake plus months of locked capital, and a gale of fake accounts still needs real money behind each one. A walnut-hard rule: identities sharing a funding source inherit each other's slashing, so one bad actor burns the whole cluster's stakes.
